dt-option.name: stateRestore.include
dt-option.summary: Define the properties that will be saved in the state

type.description:
Each property in this object defines if part of the table's state will be included in the saved state or not. The value each property can take is:
* `false` - Not included in the saved state * `true` - Will be included in the saved state * `null` - The end user has the option of including the value or not. A checkbox will be shown in the create state modal allowing them to select or deselect this value (default selected).

dt-option.default:
The following object is used as the default value:
```js { cardView: true, columnVisibility: true, columnSearch: true, columnControl: true, columnOrder: true, order: true, paging: false, scroller: false, search: true, searchBuilder: true, searchPanes: true, select: false } ```
dt-option.description:
The states that can be saved and restored by StateRestore can be "partial" - that is, it doesn't need to define every single piece of state information about a table. Indeed, in many cases it can be useful to have only specific pieces of information saved, disregarding other pieces which are more transient.
This option provides the ability to define which pieces of information will be stored in StateRestore states, with the ability to either have a part of the state included, removed or allowing the end user to make the decision in the new state modal.
Each property in the object will manipulate the state object based on the properties that it controls. The properties available, and a description of them, are shown below:
| Property | Description | Default value | | -------- | ----------- | ------------- | | `.cardView` | [CardView](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/cardview) properties | `true` - Saved | | `.columnVisibility` | Column visibility values | `true` - Saved | | `.columnSearch` | Column specific search terms | `true` - Saved | | `.columnControl` | [ColumnControl](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/columnControl) search terms | `true` - Saved | | `.columnOrder` | [ColReorder](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/colReorder) ordering | `true` - Saved | | `.order` | Column ordering | `true` - Saved | | `.paging` | Table paging (page length and start page) | `false` - Removed | | `.scroller` | [Scroller](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/scroller) properties | `false` - Removed | | `.search` | Global search terms | `true` - Saved | | `.searchBuilder` | [SearchBuilder](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/searchBuilder) search | `true` - Saved | | `.select` | [Select](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/select) properties | `false` - Removed |

example.title: Give the end user the option for some properties of the state, but disallow the saving of column ordering.
